issue.title: Record the decision that Bob Mac Capture uses Accessibility only to read and select Highlights tabs
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `decisions/mac-capture-accessibility-is-highlights-tabs-only.md`

Every bob-cli-84 phase proposed this as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note: .1 #1, .2 #2, .3 #1,
.4 #1, .5 #1, and .6 #1. It was deferred because epic bob-cli-84's auto decision
(planner default, no human review) was `decision_record = no`. Bryan must explicitly
approve before any memory edit.

Add one strand to the `decisions` web in bob-cli, for example
`sase/memory/decisions/mac-capture-accessibility-is-highlights-tabs-only.md`. Title it
"Bob Mac Capture Uses Accessibility Only To Read And Select Highlights Tabs" and follow
the web descriptor's record format:

- **Applies to.** Bob Mac Capture's Bob Refs Tabs filter.
- **Claim.** Bob Mac Capture reads Highlights' UI through Accessibility only, inside one
  reader type (`Sources/BobMacCapture/Refs/AXHighlightsTabsReader.swift`), plus the
  `AccessibilityTrust` helper for trust checks.
  - It reads only window and tab attributes.
  - It performs only `AXPress` on a tab button and `AXRaise` on its window.
  - It never edits documents, cycles tabs, uses Screen Recording, Apple Events,
    `lsof`/`libproc`, or private API.
  - It never persists tab names.
  - It never prompts at launch; the permission is requested lazily from the in-panel
    card.
- **Why.** Highlights exposes no API for its open tabs, and `lsof`/`libproc` see no
  PDFs (research E2/E3). Accessibility is the only public source of truth.
- **Cost.** The app needs an Accessibility grant, which ad-hoc builds lose on every
  reinstall. The stable "Bob Mac Capture Local" signing identity mitigates this.
- **Reopens when.** Highlights ships a scripting or URL API for tabs, or Tabs needs a
  capability beyond read and select.

Evidence:

- `research:202610/highlights_tab_switcher/highlights_tab_switcher.md` (explicit ref
  `file:explicit:9ba3692a69678bff4d21e72b`);
- `plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md`;
- bob-mac-capture commits 1cd958e (signing), 94a4e58 (tabs core), a4009a4 (model),
  1b7ead4 (views), and 1e2a9bd (entry and reader), plus the bob-cli-84 landing commit.

Then run `sase memory init` and commit the bob-cli memory change.
